about: Paragraphs the capture filed under the wrong verse, where the printed page shows them under another (see refile.mjs). from: the verse they sit under; to: the verse they belong to; prints: a fingerprint of each paragraph in order, never its words; keep: leave them under from as well, for a note the two verses share; split: instead of prints, the fingerprint of the spot where a verse's own note was run on from the end of a shared note (see breaks.mjs), cut there under every verse holding it; page: the page image it was read on.
